# Agent Dump

> Agent Dump is a local command-line tool for finding, reading, exporting, and reusing AI coding conversations. Sources remain read-only. Supported tools include Codex, Claude Code, Qoder, Qoder CN, ZCode, Kimi, Kimi-Code, OpenCode, Cursor, Droid, Grok, Pi, oh-my-pi, Gemini CLI, DSH, DeepChat, Cherry Studio, MiniMax Code, and Antigravity CLI. Formats vary by provider.

## Guides

- [All guides](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/guides/): Practical workflows and commands.
- [中文使用说明](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/zh/guides/): 六个场景的操作步骤、输出说明和限制。
- [日本語ガイド](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/ja/guides/): Codex・Claude Code のエクスポート手順（日本語）と英語ガイド一覧。
- [Export Codex sessions](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/guides/export-codex-session/): Find a URI, export Markdown or JSON, and copy the transcript into notes or another conversation.
- [Export Claude Code conversations](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/guides/export-claude-code-conversations/): Save one or several local conversations to Markdown, normalized JSON with token stats, or raw JSONL.
- [Search coding history](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/guides/search-ai-coding-history/): Full-text search, project filters, message locations, and cited excerpts.
- [Hand off context to an agent](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/guides/handoff-context-to-ai-agent/): Reading prompts, bounded JSON pages, cursors, and revision handling.
- [Create work reports](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/guides/weekly-report-from-ai-sessions/): Preview scope, configure AI collect, or generate a prompt for another agent.
- [Save to Obsidian](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/guides/save-ai-conversations-to-obsidian/): Export Markdown into a vault with a dedicated output directory.
- [将 Codex 会话导出为 Markdown](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/zh/guides/export-codex-session/): 找到本地 Codex 会话 URI、导出 Markdown 或 JSON 及排查步骤。
- [导出 Claude Code 对话](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/zh/guides/export-claude-code-conversations/): 将本地 Claude Code 会话保存为 Markdown、结构化 JSON 或原始 JSONL。
- [搜索 AI 编码历史](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/zh/guides/search-ai-coding-history/): 全文搜索、按项目筛选、定位消息并导出带引用的上下文片段。
- [把历史对话交给下一个 AI Agent](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/zh/guides/handoff-context-to-ai-agent/): 读取提示词、有界 JSON 分页、续读游标与版本一致性。
- [从 AI 编码会话生成日报或周报](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/zh/guides/weekly-report-from-ai-sessions/): 预览范围、内置 AI 汇总或外部 Agent 提示词交接。
- [将 AI 对话保存到 Obsidian](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/zh/guides/save-ai-conversations-to-obsidian/): 按独立输出目录将 Markdown 导出到 Obsidian 笔记库。
- [Codex セッションを Markdown・JSON にエクスポート](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/ja/guides/export-codex-session/): ローカル Codex セッションの URI 確認、Markdown・JSON 出力、トラブルシューティング。
- [Claude Code セッションを Markdown・JSON にエクスポート](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/ja/guides/export-claude-code-conversations/): ローカル Claude Code セッションの Markdown・構造化 JSON・一括エクスポート。

## Behavior boundaries

- Search and direct export operate locally without a model API key. AI collect sends selected conversation content to the configured model provider.
- --read-prompt and --collect --emit-prompt produce instructions; they do not launch another agent.
- Exported transcripts do not restore a running agent, its environment, or its execution state.
- Cursor supports JSON and print, not Markdown or raw export.
